title: Authorize customer master data with live menu authority and bounded field validation
description: Stage 3 master-data closure for the customer records that every sales order, quotation, proforma invoice, loading list, receipt and salesperson data-scope decision resolves against. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:29 declares CustomerController with only [ApiController]/[Route(`api/base/customers`)]/[Authorize]; only the read routes resolve identity through ERP-097 SalespersonDataScopeService (GetPaged 47-54, GetAll 57-63, GetById 66-74), while GetForwarderOptions at 39-44 and the inherited generic Create/Update/Delete/BatchDelete routes in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:62-92 delegate to IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs, zero Authoriz/Menu references) so any authenticated account can mint, rewrite and soft-delete customers; no route enforces the existing customer functional menu (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:25) and no route applies bounded field validation. Reuse that existing customer menu on every route, add bounded server-side validation for the persisted BaseCustomer columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseCustomer.cs:10-143), and keep the existing customer-code unique index (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:29), the ERP-097 read scope and CustomerForwarderService semantics (src/ERP.Application/Services/CustomerForwarderService.cs) unchanged. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no grants, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/base/customers (paged, all, by-id, forwarder-options, create, update, delete and batch-delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing customer functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors while preserving the ERP-097 salesperson read scope and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that CustomerCode and CustomerName are non-empty and within their persisted length bounds, that the optional persisted customer text, decimal and integer fields stay within their persisted bounds and known shapes, and that Status is a known enabled/disabled value, returning the existing controlled validation errors without silently clamping or rewriting any customer row and keeping the existing customer-code uniqueness, ERP-097 read scope and forwarder reference semantics unchanged, so a rejected write persists no BaseCustomers row.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing customer menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid code, name, bounds and status payloads, and assert that denied paged, all, by-id, forwarder-options, create, update, delete and batch-delete calls read or mutate no BaseCustomers row while the existing CustomerForwarderTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:29 declares CustomerController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/base/customers)]/[Authorize]; GetPaged 47-54, GetAll 57-63 and GetById 66-74 apply only the ERP-097 SalespersonDataScopeService filter, GetForwarderOptions at 39-44 calls CustomerForwarderService.LoadOptionsAsync with no caller/menu resolution, and Create 94-99 / Update 104-113 call CustomerForwarderService.ApplyAsync then base.Create/base.Update, while Delete and BatchDelete are inherited from src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:79-92 whose routes (38-92) call IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs, zero Authoriz/Menu/scope references). BaseCustomer (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseCustomer.cs:10-143) persists CustomerCode(50)/CustomerName(200)/EnglishName/ContactPerson/Phone/Email/Country/Address/PaymentTerms/CreditLimit/DepositRatio/TaxNumber/EmpId/Status/Currency/TradeTerms/Consignee/NotifyParty/DefaultShippingMark/CreditDays/CommissionRatio/CustomerLevel/CreditStatus/Source/Remark with only attribute annotations; the unique index is src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:29 and the existing customer menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:25. There is no CustomerAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services, and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing CustomerController for live authorization (ERP-036 only added the forwarder reference). src/ERP.Api/Program.cs:152-153 registers only exception/log middleware, confirming no global menu gate.
